title: A column generation-based fixed-point heuristic for the service-aware multi-commodity flow problem
summary: We study the Service-Aware Multi-Commodity Flow (SAMCF) problem, in which demand is elastic and governed by a logit choice model while routing is subject to hard capacity constraints. In a centralized, system-optimal setting, the network operator jointly determines how much demand to serve and how to route it. We formulate the SAMCF as a nonlinear program and propose an iterative fixed-point heuristic that alternates between solving an inelastic MCF via column generation and updating demand from the resulting service levels.
